instruction: `ValueCreator.Create` (flag_impl.go) cannot report a bad default or config: it returns only a `Value`. Change its return type to `(Value, error)`, so the interface method becomes `Create(T, *T, C) (Value, error)`. Change every implementation (boolValue, durationValue, floatValue, genericValue, intValue, uintValue, stringValue, textValue, timestampValue, MapBase, SliceBase and any other) to the new signature; the existing implementations never fail and return a nil error. Update every caller, in source and in tests, to handle the error: where the calling function returns an error, return it (`ArgumentBase.Parse`, `ArgumentsBase.Parse`, `FlagBase.PreParse`, and `MapBase.Create` / `SliceBase.Create`, which call the element creator); in tests, fail the test on a non-nil error (`require.NoError`/`t.Fatal`), or panic inside helper closures that have no `*testing.T`. Do not keep a single-result variant or wrapper. Do not touch unrelated `Create` functions such as `os.Create`. Behavior must not change.
gold_tool: build_deep.py go recipe: declarations by pattern (return type Value -> (Value, error), `return x` -> `return x, nil` in their bodies), callers rewritten by explicit per-site edits, go build + go test compile clean (go1.25.14 GOTOOLCHAIN=local); gofmt
change: change return type T -> (T, error) (generic interface method: 12 implementations + callers that must restructure expression uses into error handling)
notes: Call sites are guarded by the compiler (a two-result call in single-value context does not compile) and by the single-value-use regex shape.
